data.title: Regression Test
data.tagline: Regression testing checks that a change has not broken functionality that previously worked.
data.learningOutcome: You can select previously working paths that need rechecking based on change risk.
data.description: After tax changes, rerun payment, coupons, and confirmation; after dependency upgrades, rerun critical pages. It selects old capabilities the change could affect, not only the new request. A new feature working does not prove no regression.

learning.assumes: You know one code change can affect nearby functions that seem unrelated.
learning.outcome: You can select previously working paths that need rechecking based on change risk.

distinctions.label: Smoke test
distinctions.explanation: A Regression Test reruns existing behavior according to change risk. A Smoke Test first checks only basic abilities such as home, login, and a core API.

explanation.title: Find old cases from the impact surface
explanation.text: Because tax participates in order total, rerun coupons, payment amount, and confirmation—not merely the new rate. Scope comes from data and flow connections, not mechanically rerunning everything.

explanation.title: Use prior expectations to catch surprises
explanation.text: A checkout that used to complete, an amount that used to be correct, or an old clear error that changes after this edit is a regression worth addressing. Compare results before and after.

data.boundary: Regression is not testing the new feature itself, nor is it smoke testing. Smoke quickly asks whether a version is plainly usable; regression asks whether a change harmed related, previously working capabilities.

lessonPractice.title: The team changed only coupon calculation, but the total also affects payment and order confirmation. Which set belongs in regression?

options.label: Existing coupon, payment-total, and order-confirmation cases
options.feedback: Correct. These older paths depend on the total and are most likely to be harmed by the change.

options.label: Only check that the new coupon displays
options.feedback: Displaying the new rule does not prove old payment and confirmation results remain correct.

options.label: Only check profile-avatar upload
options.feedback: Without a known shared dependency, it is not in this change's main risk area.

data.agentPrompt: After changing tax and coupon rules, run regression by impact: retest existing coupons, payment totals, and order confirmation. Do not only report the new rule passing; list the actual result for each older path.
